DOP: caṅgavāra n. [?; cf AMg caṅgabera, “a large metal pan” ], a strainer; a sieve ; M I 142, 31 foll. (addasa ~aṃ, ~aṃ bhadante ti, Ce, Ee so; Be ~o bhadante ti; Se paṅka-vāraṃ, paṅkavāro bhadante ti; Ps II 128, 10 : ~an ti khāra-parissāvanaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se caṅkavāran ti); 144, 21 (~an ti kho bhikkhu pañcann’ etaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se paṅkavāran ti); Ja V 186, 14* (upanīyat’ idaṃ maññe parittaṃ udakaṃ va ~amhi, Ce, Ee so; Be caṅkavāramhi; Se paṅkavāramhi; 186, 27´ foll. : yathā parittaṃ udakaṃ rajakānaṃ khāra-caṅgavāre pakkhittaṃ sīghaṃ pariyādiyati, Ce, Ee so; Be khāracaṅkavāre; Se khārapaṅkavāre); Ud-a 403, 14 (~e pakkhitta-udakaṃ viya parikkhayaṃ gataṃ).
NCP: neuter a | ca"ngavaara strainer, a sieve.

DOP: caṅgoṭaka caṅkoṭaka m.n. [?; cf AMg caṅgerī, caṅgeriā, “a flat basket to keep flowers in” ], a box or basket (often of bamboo, or of gold, esp. for flowers), a trug ; Abh 317 (~o karaṇḍo ca, Ce so; Be caṅkoṭako); Ja V 110, 7 (~e kappāsapicuṃ attharitvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se caṅkoṭake); 303, 20´ (tesaṃ pupphānaṃ ~aṃ pūretvā, Ce, Ee so; Se caṅkoṭakaṃ; Be suvaṇṇacaṅkoṭakaṃ); Ap 118, 6 (~e ṭhapetvāna anojaṃ puppham uttamaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se caṅkoṭake); 434, 28 (~aṃ gahetvāna, Ee so; Se caṅkoṭakaṃ; Be, Ce sakosakaṃ); Vism 173, 3 (pupphāni gahetvā … ~aṃ vā karaṇḍapaṭalaṃ vā pattehi yeva samatittikaṃ pūretvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se caṅkoṭakaṃ); Sp 1244, 15 (… vījanī ~aṃ pacchi …, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be caṅkoṭakaṃ); Dhp-a III 101, 20 (tā ~ehi gandhamālādīni gāhāpetvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se caṅkoṭakehi); Vv-a 158, 19 (suvaṇṇapupphehi gandhajātehi ca pūritāni ~āni gāhāpetvā gantukāmā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se caṅkoṭakāni); Ap-a 392, 27 (~aṃ pūretvā, Ce so; Ee ~asmiṃ; Be, Se caṅkoṭakaṃ); — ifc see dhātu-, mālā-.
